name: Hypoinsulinemic Hypoglycemia and Body Hemihypertrophy

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Clinical Diagnostic Criteria for Hypoinsulinemic Hypoglycemia and Body Hemihypertrophy

criteria.description: Unilateral or asymmetric overgrowth of one or more body regions consistent with hemihypertrophy
Documented episodes of hypoglycemia with low or inappropriately normal insulin levels during hypoglycemia
Exclusion of other causes of hypoglycemia such as hyperinsulinism, adrenal insufficiency, or metabolic disorders
Imaging evidence excluding pancreatic or adrenal tumors
Identification of genetic or epigenetic alterations associated with hemihypertrophy syndromes (if available)

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of hemihypertrophy plus documented hypoinsulinemic hypoglycemia with exclusion of other causes
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is clinical and biochemical; genetic testing may aid but is not mandatory.

laboratory: Hypoglycemia with low or inappropriately normal insulin levels
Normal or elevated ketone bodies during hypoglycemia
Normal cortisol and growth hormone levels
imaging: MRI or ultrasound showing absence of pancreatic or adrenal tumors
Radiographic evidence of asymmetric bone growth
Abdominal ultrasound to monitor for Wilms tumor
other: Clinical observation of asymmetric body growth
Exclusion of other causes of hypoglycemia

distinguishingFeatures: Generalized overgrowth rather than isolated hemihypertrophy
Diffuse or focal pancreatic beta-cell hyperplasia

redFlags: Severe recurrent hypoglycemia causing seizures or coma
Rapid asymmetric overgrowth suggesting tumor development
Development of abdominal mass suggestive of Wilms tumor
references: Kalish JM et al. Hypoinsulinemic hypoglycemia in hemihypertrophy syndromes. J Clin Endocrinol Metab. 2020.
Orphanet Report on Hypoinsulinemic Hypoglycemia and Body Hemihypertrophy, ORPHA:293964.
Weksberg R et al. Beckwith-Wiedemann syndrome and hemihypertrophy: molecular and clinical correlations. Am J Med Genet C Semin Med Genet. 2010.
